artifacts.notes: Complete offered digital delivery, not a complete physical copy or checked text. Retained without recompression or any edits. The PDF contains searchable machine text but its OCR is unreliable. PDF 1 reports substantial missing leaves; these gaps are not filled from another printing. Attribution: Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia, INC-35; Lau Haizeetara, item 20.500.11938/69046.
artifacts.rights_basis: The underlying 1500 Latin printing and historical two-dimensional material are public domain in the United States by expired publication term. The holding library marks this exact digital item Public Domain Mark at https://liburutegibiltegi.bizkaia.eus/handle/20.500.11938/69046 and explicitly states free use without prior authorization, with author/integrity attribution and recommended credit to Lau Haizeetara (Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia). Its modern factual copy-description card at PDF page 1 is retained unchanged as part of that offered delivery; individual bibliographic/copy-condition facts are not claimed as project authorship. The source’s generic website wrapper has separate reserved-rights notices and is not included. This facsimile is excluded from Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 offer.

edition.authority: The colophon attributes the printing to the mandate of Bishop Guillermus Raymundus de Moncada and the dean and cathedral chapter, with correction by Johannes Petrus Navarro assisted by Antonius de Anyo and Matheus Castante. This is the book’s own commissioning statement; no separate promulgating instrument or date of effective reception is claimed.
